procedure: A/B caption names masked;model mapping not opened before sealing. Aggregate val scores already known;no per-pair metrics/reference captions displayed. Same material factual/coverage preference rule as Real review.

rows.notes: Both capture new blue word on shutter. Hazard sign remains visible on barrel,with another small sign/marker near ladder possibly changing; exact targeted sign/size versus removal is unclear at displayed resolution.

Both capture table moved toward back/right and new red chair/sofa foreground. A has doubtful before left-of-sofa wording;B has doubtful new-sofa near-left-door placement. Main events retained by both;no clear overall winner.
Both correctly identify the added blue Pub lettering at the same wall location; paraphrase only.
Both identify brighter lighting and added potted plant beside the furniture; small location wording differences do not change material coverage.
Both correctly describe the reduced illumination; equivalent content.
Both identify added man and moved slab. B correctly says the man faces screen right; A says left. Fine leg/hand details are hard to verify.
Both capture added person and blue word. B avoids A unsupported hanging-chairs location;both omit the additional pendant lamp visible in the after image.
Both capture added Cowp sign and chair color change. B adds a ceiling lampshade disappearance although the center hanging fixture remains visible;A avoids that unsupported event.
Both capture added blue Camp sign. A places it right of the framed decoration,which matches the image;B incorrectly puts it above a picture frame.

Both capture removed person/word and changed high chair. A says two cushions shrank;B says right cushion disappeared. Cushion geometry is hard to distinguish from removal at this resolution,so no confident overall preference.
Both correctly capture new stool and TV. Both add questionable small decoration/cup/blanket events;fine shelf details are not clear enough for a reliable overall preference.
A captures the visible new black-white patterned cushion on left sofa. B claims an unsupported cushion relocation and right armchair shrink;both mention brightness which is subtle.
Both capture added coffee machine. The large green plant is still visible toward the left,so A relocation description is preferable to B claim that it is absent.
Both correctly capture added suited person and removed Service Hall text;equivalent material coverage.
Both correctly describe thermos removal and added suited person;minor facing-direction phrasing does not establish a material overall difference.

Both identify new deer ornament but add questionable small-object claims. A additionally invents a bear and removal of a black sculpture;B has fewer plainly unsupported events,though it is not fully correct.
Both capture added thermos and removed second picture. B additionally claims air-conditioner relocation,although it remains at the same upper wall position;A avoids this false event.

Both capture plant growth and describe a pendant change. Their orientation words differ but the lamp also visibly changes position;neither direction description is clear enough for a confident preference.
Both capture chair turning away. A describes rug reduction,consistent with smaller visible rug remaining under the coffee table;B incorrectly says complete disappearance.
Both capture repose-to-repase text change and man turning. A places his new facing direction toward back door,matching visible back-facing pose;B says facing left sofa in foreground.
